answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 80 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The beacon register is checked at draw time, inlet lists the eligible set, and quartz seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 80 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. That is 14 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
